name: Vasudeva 2015
question: For long-segment incomplete bulbar urethral stricture, how do dorsal and ventral onlay buccal mucosal graft urethroplasty compare?

arms.label: Dorsal onlay buccal mucosal graft urethroplasty
ventral onlay buccal mucosal graft urethroplasty

design.population: Patients with long-segment (>2 cm), incomplete bulbar urethral stricture meeting the study's eligibility criteria.
design.locator: Full text, Methods and Results, pp 968-969

verdictNote: Primary IPSS and Qmax comparisons were nonsignificant; no sample-size calculation was reported.
takeaway: In 80 randomized patients with long-segment incomplete bulbar stricture, dorsal and ventral onlay buccal grafts had similar 12-month IPSS and Qmax among 38 patients per arm. Surgical success was 37/40 versus 36/40 (P = 0.51).

reports.label: Initial randomized report
reports.citation: Vasudeva P, Nanda B, Kumar A, et al. "Dorsal versus ventral onlay buccal mucosal graft urethroplasty for long-segment bulbar urethral stricture: A prospective randomized study." *Int J Urol.* 2015;22(10):967-971. doi:10.1111/iju.12859
reports.followUpLocator: Full text, Methods and Results, pp 968-970

results.measure: Mean IPSS at 12 months among patients without 3-month failure (n = 38 per arm)
results.note: Baseline means were 24.10 and 23.90; 3-month means were 4.95 and 4.80 (P = 0.86). Two 3-month failures per arm were excluded from 12-month means. Between-arm P threshold was 0.05; no confidence interval was reported.
results.locator: Full text, Methods, p 968; Table 3, p 970

results.measure: Mean Qmax at 12 months (mL/s) among patients without 3-month failure (n = 38 per arm)
results.note: Baseline means were 5.57 and 5.68 mL/s; 3-month means were 18.21 and 18.09 mL/s (P = 0.87). Two 3-month failures per arm were excluded from 12-month means. Between-arm P threshold was 0.05; no confidence interval was reported.
results.locator: Full text, Methods, p 968; Table 3, p 970

results.measure: 12-month freedom from failure (no further surgery and Qmax ≥14 mL/s), among 40 randomized per arm
results.note: Two failures in each arm occurred by 3 months, with one further dorsal and two further ventral failures by 12 months. Redo urethroplasty was planned for all failures.
results.locator: Full text, Methods, p 968; Results, p 969; Table 4, p 970

harms.label: Wound infection and graft necrosis
harms.note: Reported as one combined category; P = 0.32; managed conservatively.

delivery.label: Operative duration
delivery.locator: Full text, Surgical procedure, p 968; Table 2, p 969
delivery.note: P = 0.43. Two consultant urologists used modified Barbagli dorsal onlay or Wessells ventral onlay; separate teams harvested graft and dissected perineum.

delivery.label: Graft length and catheter protocol
delivery.locator: Full text, Surgical procedure, p 968; Table 2, p 969
delivery.note: Graft-length P = 0.81. Pericatheter urethrogram at 4 weeks; catheter removed if no extravasation, otherwise retained one more week. No crossover permitted.
